name: action-sheet
props: Called on actions, Cancel, backdrop tap, drag-down, back and Escape.
{ label, icon?, destructive?, disabled?, color?, onPress? }[]

The options. `icon` is a built-in name (camera, image, trash, reply, forward, copy, pin, edit, share, link, mail, …) or a node; destructive rows use the danger colour; return false from onPress to stay open; `color` tints grid tiles.
Separate cancel button; null hides it.
Called on Cancel, backdrop tap and drag-to-dismiss.
iOS grouped cards (text-only rows centred in the accent; rows with icons read like a menu), Material edge-to-edge list with a drag handle, or share-sheet tiles.
Padding above the home indicator; pass useSafeAreaInsets().bottom for the device.
Colour of text-only actions and Cancel in the inset variant.
Close on scrim tap, drag, back and Escape. When false the sheet only rubber-bands.
Light impact on open, selection tick when an action is picked.
